name: NYCHA Development Data Book
description: Contains the main body of the "Development Data Book". The Development Data Book lists all of the Authority's Developments alphabetically and includes information on the development identification numbers, program and construction type, number of apartments and rental rooms, population, number of buildings and stories, street boundaries, and political districts.

columns.name: DEVELOPMENT
columns.description: Development name.

columns.name: HUD AMP#
columns.description: Asset Management Project (AMP) numbers.

columns.name: TDS#
columns.description: The number used by numerous computer applications to identify NYCHA Developments.

columns.name: CONSOLIDATED TDS#
columns.description: Consolidated Tenant Data Systems number.

columns.name: DEVELOPMENT EDP#
columns.description: Assigned to a development during the development (construction) period.

columns.name: OPERATING EDP#
columns.description: A number that each development utilize for Operating Costs.

columns.name: HUD #
columns.description: The U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD) identification number.

columns.name: PROGRAM
columns.description: The Programs designations are: Federal, MHOP, Mixed Finance, Mixed Finance/LLC1, Mixed Finance LLC2, Mixed Finance/Non-NYCHA Development.

columns.name: METHOD
columns.description: Two items in this field Conventional and Turnkey.

columns.name: TYPE
columns.description: 5 items in this field: Gut Rehab, New Const, New Const (Eld), Rehab, and Rehab (Eld).

columns.name: NUMBER OF SECTION 8 TRANSITION APARTMENTS
columns.description: The total number of apartments transitioned to the Section 8 Program in the LLC1 developments.

columns.name: NUMBER OF CURRENT APARTMENTS
columns.description: The number of units available for occupancy in the development as per the January 1, 2024 Dwelling Unit Inventory which is used to track the number of units on the rent roll.

columns.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF APARTMENTS
columns.description: The total number of apartments at the development including the Section 8 Transition apartments at the LLC1 developments.

columns.name: NUMBER OF RENTAL ROOMS
columns.description: Rental room count per unit is equal to 2 1/2 plus the number of bedrooms. The number of rental rooms includes balconies and half-bath as half-rooms.

columns.name: AVG NO R/R PER APARTMENT
columns.description: The average number of rental rooms per apartment is the number of rental rooms divided by the number of current units. The Section 8 units in the LLC1 Developments are included.

columns.name: POPULATION SECTION 8 TRANSITION
columns.description: The number of persons living in the Section 8 Transition units in the LLC1 developments.

columns.name: POPULATION PUBLIC HOUSING
columns.description: The number of persons living in all public housing units. The residents living in the Section 8 Transition units in the LLC1 developments are not included in this population count.

columns.name: TOTAL POPULATION
columns.description: The total number of persons living at the developments, including the Section 8 Transition apartments in the LLC1 developments.

columns.name: TOTAL # OF FIXED INCOME HOUSEHOLD
columns.description: Number of households on fixed income (households with income from Social Security, Supplementary Security Income (SSI), Survivors Insurance, Veterans Benefits, or Pension (as well as other Public or Non Public Benefits), while not earning employment income or receiving Public Assistance.

columns.name: PERCENT FIXED INCOME HOUSEHOLDS
columns.description: Number of households on fixed income divided by the total number of households.

columns.name: NUMBER OF RESIDENTIAL BLDGS
columns.description: The number of residential buildings on the grounds that are used for dwelling units.

columns.name: NUMBER OF NON-RESIDENTIAL BLDGS
columns.description: The number of non-residential buildings at a development.

columns.name: NUMBER OF STAIRHALLS
columns.description: The number of individual entrances in each development.

columns.name: NUMBER OF STORIES
columns.description: The number of floors in each building.

columns.name: TOTAL AREA SQ FT
columns.description: This number includes land acquired and developed as part of the development for a park or playground to be operated and manintained by the NYC Department of Parks. At State and City Developments, the park or playground is owned by the City of New York. At federal Developments, parks and playgrounds are leased to the City.

columns.name: ACRES
columns.description: The land area of the development including buildings and grounds is shown in acres (one acre equals 43,560 square feet).

columns.name: NET DEV AREA SQ FT
columns.description: This is Square Feet at a Development less the land set aside for a park or playground. For the majority of developments this figure is the same acreage.

columns.name: EXCLUDING PARK ACRES
columns.description: This is the number of acres at a development less the land set aside for a park or playground. For the majority of developments this figure is the same as "acres".

columns.name: BLDG COVERAGE SQ FT
columns.description: The total ground floor area of the building footprints of a development.

columns.name: CUBAGE CU FT
columns.description: Cubic Space (height x length x width of residential buildings) in all the buildings at a development, expressed as cubic feet.

columns.name: BLDG COVERAGE %
columns.description: This is the building coverage, divided by a development’s total area in square feet. This figure is presented as a percentage.

columns.name: DENSITY
columns.description: Measure of development density as represented by the number of persons per acre.

columns.name: DEVELOPMENT COST
columns.description: The sum of the land cost, construction cost and site improvement cost, including fees for architects and engineers at the time of original construction.

columns.name: PER RENTAL ROOM
columns.description: Cost to develop the property divided by the number of rental rooms at the time of original construction.

columns.name: AVG MONTHLY GROSS RENT
columns.description: This is the average gross monthly rent of the households in each development. The average tenant share of rent for the Section 8 households in the LLC1 developments is included.

columns.name: LOCATION STREET A
columns.description: For NYCHA Developments that fit into a relatively neat rectangular block or two, these fields should be the four border streets (north, south, east, and west) of the Development. For Developments that are spread over some distance such as West Farms Road Rehab, the streets that best define the location of the development are provided.

columns.name: BOROUGH
columns.description: Bronx, Brooklyn, Manhattan, Queens, or Staten Island.

columns.name: COMMUNITY DISTIRCT
columns.description: Community District Number.

columns.name: US CONGRESSIONAL DISTRICT
columns.description: Congressional District Number.

columns.name: NY STATE SENATE DISTRICT
columns.description: New York State Senate District Number.

columns.name: NY STATE ASSEMBLY DISTRICT
columns.description: New York State Assembly District Number.

columns.name: NY CITY COUNCIL DISTRICT
columns.description: New York City Council District Number.

columns.name: COMPLETION DATE
columns.description: The Initial Occupancy Completion Date: The date when the development was at least 95% occupied.

columns.name: FEDERALIZED DEVELOPMENT
columns.description: Date on which City and / or State Developments were transferred to the Federal Program. There are 11 items in this field. They are: 1968/08/29-Fed Tran; 1971/06/29-Fed Tran; 1972/06/29-Fed Tran; 1977/07/01-ATP 1 (abbreviation for Authority Transfer Program); 1978/02/01-ATP 2; 1978/07/01-ATP 3; 1979/08/01-ATP 4; 1980/07/01-ATP 5; 1980/10/01-ATP 7; and 1995/07/13-PTA (abbreviation for Physical Transfer of Assets).

columns.name: SENIOR DEVELOPMENT
columns.description: A senior development where all residents are senior, aged 62 or older, is denoted as "Exclusively". A development where only some buildings are designated for senior residents is denoted as "Partially".

columns.name: ELECTRICITY PAID BY RESIDENTS
columns.description: A "Yes" indicates developments where residents pay for their electricity.

columns.name: PRIVATE MANAGEMENT
columns.description: A "Yes" indicates developments managed by a private management company.

columns.name: RAD TRANSFERRED DATE
columns.description: The date when the development underwent a Rental Assistance (RAD) / Permanent Affordability Commitment Together (PACT) conversion.
